posts.text:
Microsoft benchmark finds agents often claim success but leave databases wrong
https://theaipost.net/story/find-microsoft-thinkingbox/

OpenAI's Jalapeño chip has 216 GiB of HBM4 and was tuned by its models

OpenAI says its models saved over 13 percent of Jalapeño's die area and lifted one attention kernel from under 1 percent to nearly 90 percent of peak efficiency in 40 hours.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-jalapeno-hotchips-specs/

Strata repo runs 125B Qwen model on a single gaming GPU

Strata, an MIT-licensed runner for Alibaba's 125B Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, has 9,500 GitHub stars after four days. Its author reports 53 to 94 tokens a second on an RTX 5070.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-strata-qwen-flash-next/

Seoul orders probe after suspected AI-assisted hacks hit 7 financial firms
https://theaipost.net/story/find-korea-ai-bank-hacks/

Coding-agent add-ons ponytail and caveman pass 100,000 GitHub stars

Ponytail claims 54 percent fewer lines of code and caveman claims 33 percent fewer input tokens. Both are free add-ons for coding agents, at 154,000 and 110,000 stars.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-agent-skill-repos-trending/

Open-source kit lets Claude Code mod single-player PC games

The universal-modder repo has 2,800 stars and 244 forks four days after launch. Its author says an agent can use it to reverse-engineer a game and add art, 3D models and audio.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-universal-modder/

Perplexity says its decision API cleared Pokémon FireRed's Elite Four

Chief executive Aravind Srinivas posted a video of the run, saying the API answered in a median 592 milliseconds and the whole run cost an estimated $0.028.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-perplexity-pokemon-firered/

Aleph Alpha says Chinese models give balanced answers 17 to 41 percent
https://theaipost.net/story/find-aleph-alpha-chinese-model-bias/

Google to cut free Gemini users to Flash-Lite and give AI Pro Deep Think
https://theaipost.net/story/gemini-tier-model-limits/

Meta opens Muse Gadgets, a DIY kit for building AI hardware

Meta says its Apache 2.0 kit pairs ESP32 firmware and a Linux SDK with its Muse agent, and 5,000 USB-C Home Link devices are due within weeks.

https://theaipost.net/story/c9066725a/

White House names Clayton to lead AI 'Super Intelligence Force'

Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton will lead a White House task force with 120 days to report on AI's risks and opportunities, the Wall Street Journal reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-clayton-si-force/

Willison says coding agents mean pay-per-use services need hard spending caps
https://theaipost.net/story/simonw-hard-budget-caps/
